summary.intent: Fix a broken GSD stop-hook error (MODULE_NOT_FOUND for gsd-context-monitor.js), update GSD to 1.6.0, remove stale worktrees, then autonomously plan and execute Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) through to ship.
summary.outcome: Statusline fixed (renamed to .cjs), GSD reinstalled to 1.6.0 (restoring missing hooks), three worktrees removed, and Phase 61 fully planned (5 plans/4 waves), executed (196 TS + 97 Rust tests green), verified (4/4 must-haves), and security-reviewed (SHIP verdict). Ship loop was in progress (applying 6 CodeRabbit findings) at transcript end.

repo: repo has `"type": "module"` in package.json — all .js files in the project are treated as ESM; Claude Code hook scripts using require() must use the .cjs extension

GSD hooks are gitignored via `.gitignore:55` (pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*`) and installed locally by GSD, not tracked in the repo — branch switches and fresh clones will have missing hooks until GSD is reinstalled

The main-tree GSD install can silently become a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, manifest, most workflows) while worktrees retain full installs — the manifest lives only where a complete install ran
Vitest is configured with `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` in @cipherbox/crypto — tests placed at `packages/crypto/__tests__/` are never discovered; the correct path is `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/`
`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array — adding a new KAT vector file (e.g. node-aad.json) requires editing this array or the CI parity-check step fails
`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV and cannot produce deterministic KAT output; fixed-IV cross-language KATs must target the lower-level `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` pair directly
The `uuid` crate is not present in the workspace; adding it requires two-step addition to both root `Cargo.toml` workspace.dependencies and the consuming crate's `Cargo.toml`

Root `tsconfig.scripts.json` has `types: ["node"]` but `@types/node` is not hoisted to root node_modules/@types/ — `pnpm tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json` fails with TS2688 (pre-existing, unrelated to AAD changes)
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL — PR body must be patched via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`
GSD executor agents pre-delivered Rust seal variants (plan 02) before the plan that specified them (plan 04) — downstream plans should defensively check before re-implementing
GSD 1.6.0 reinstall is interactive when stale fragment files exist (gsd_run, gsd-ensure-canonical-path.js) — requires keep/remove resolution; passing it non-interactively requires the `--remove` flag
The `.gitignore` comment pinned `@opengsd/gsd-core@1.6.0` as the expected version while worktrees were running 1.4.3 — the main-tree fragment was even older/broken

code.finding: Contains a hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS bash array — every new KAT vector file must be registered here manually or the CI parity-check step fails with exit non-zero even when both TS and Rust tests pass
Renamed from statusline.js to force CommonJS mode; CodeRabbit flagged execSync missing a timeout and Windows path handling — deferred as out-of-scope for the crypto phase
uuidToBytes currently throws a plain Error (not CryptoError INVALID_AAD_INPUT) for 32-char non-hex input — CodeRabbit flagged this; fix applied in ship loop
node_aad_cross_language test asserts vectors are non-empty but does not pin exact count to 4 — CodeRabbit fix applied to assert exact role set and count
TS aad_vectors KAT iterated without a length assertion — vacuous pass if roles 0x02/0x03/0x04 are dropped; hardened to require toHaveLength(4) and role-set assertion [1,2,3,4]
seal_vectors KAT iterated without a non-empty/length guard — same vacuous-pass hole as aad_vectors; hardened to require length > 0 assertion

workflow: For sequential single-plan waves that share an output file (e.g. node-aad.json written in wave 1, read in wave 2), disable worktrees and run on the main tree — avoids slow pnpm install per worktree and serialization conflicts
GSD commit helper false-negatives are common — always verify with `git log --oneline -1` after any commit; never retry blindly
CodeRabbit CLI `--base main` uses the LOCAL main ref, which can be stale and inflate the diff to 661 files; always use `--base origin/main` to match the actual PR merge base

For security-critical crypto, run adversarial multi-lens plan verification (goal-backward + parity-rigor + IV-safety + threat-model lenses) in addition to the canonical plan-checker — caught vacuous-pass KAT holes before execution
AFK sessions that will hit 1Password SSH agent need `git config commit.gpgsign false` locally set upfront — biometric prompts hang subagent commits
Vector KAT plans must explicitly assert array lengths (not just iterate) — a for...of over an empty array always passes, silently destroying coverage invariants
Security review with third-implementation proof (recomputing KAT ciphertext via OpenSSL independently) is a strong adversarial verification pattern for crypto phases
STATE.md `update` helper can silently no-op on some transitions — always verify the written state and hand-fix if the Current Position wasn't advanced

Plan verification workflow: run canonical checker + adversarial lenses in parallel with a convergence round if blockers surface; warnings are worth hardening before execution at plan-time (cheaper than post-execution)
When a phase is purely additive (zero consumers of new exports), the regression risk is minimal — grep for consumers early to scope downstream typecheck work

friction: GSD main-tree install was silently a broken fragment — gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-context-monitor.js, gsd-file-manifest.json, and most workflows missing; the Stop hook fired and errored every turn until reinstall
